card.text: Explore Hektor in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Hektor is a Jupiter Trojan asteroid. Explore its calibrated convex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2016-06-27. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. This is the published convex reconstruction of the primary alone; it does not resolve the proposed lobes or its satellite.

shape.title: DAMIT model 232
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
